build_arg_parser_for_image_training: build an argparse parser for image dataset training with batch size, epochs, and learning rate options
configure_ode_solver_options: configure the ODE solver method and options like midpoint or dopri5 for sample generation
set_optimizer_parameters: set optimizer parameters including learning rate, betas, and linear decay for training
configure_discrete_flow_matching: configure discrete flow matching training with symmetric term, temperature, and sampling steps
set_distributed_training_params: set distributed training parameters including world size, local rank, and dist URL
